column1: # EXPECTED TRANSCRIPT of journey.d/jpriv1.sh (JPRIV1): what a GREEN run must show. NOT FROM A RUN.

# build yet, so none of this has executed. Devnet quality; privacy not audited.

# `check`/`expectgot` rows, `OPERATOR` for operator rows, else the friend. Every listed row must appear
# in the run's jpriv1.tsv with verdict `ok`, and no row may be FAIL. `rooms-e2e.sh` compares; the order
# is the script's order but is not enforced (an extra row is not an error, a missing or red one is).
# Each substring is a literal of the script (rooms-e2e.sh --self-check proves that).
